answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes: a newcomer locks 200 POA in escrow. The bond is a bridge from claimed history to trust, unlocking once the fingerprint matches the claim over 20 epochs. Honest agents wander across many partners, so the fingerprint forms naturally; any delta freezes the bond. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 200,000 POA for 20 epochs against a ~2,000 POA pool; an honest agent pays one bond and keeps its share undiluted.
